raw_response:
I am thinking like this: my land is only 6.5 mu, so I cannot be too fancy. I still keep wheat and maize on the same 4.5 mu because that is the steady way here, and I leave 2 mu for cotton so the family is not depending on only one crop. I do mostly what has worked on my fields and what I see nearby. If I cut fertilizer too much, I worry the crop will go weak; if I spend too much, then there is no cash left if someone gets sick or the pump costs more. Since some people in my family work outside, I also need work that can be done in the right window without too much hired labor. For wheat I will not skimp too much on base fertilizer, because if wheat starts weak in autumn it is hard to make up later. For maize, the time after wheat harvest is very tight, so I will clear the field fast, do light tillage, and plant quickly. Cotton is slower and takes more hand work, so I only keep a small area.
